EXACTLY a 4 column by 4 row evenly spaced grid of 16 full isolated tower sprites, no text, no labels, no borders. Transparent background with real alpha. NO ground scene, no square opaque tile backgrounds, no UI, no text. Not an existing copyrighted character. Complete sprite inside each cell.
